editions.titreEditorial: OpenAI freezes part of Astra over cyber risk
editions.chapeau: OpenAI has paused part of the work on Astra, a building block of its future ChatGPT, because the model can find and exploit previously unknown vulnerabilities on its own. Meta is opening up Muse Glimmer, an open-weight model light enough for a laptop, China acknowledges that it still trains its best models on Nvidia chips, and the French power grid is buckling under the weight of data centre projects.

editions.titreEditorial: Jeff Dean leaves Google as DeepMind reshuffles its command
editions.chapeau: Google reorganises its AI leadership: Jeff Dean departs to found a scientific-discovery start-up, Demis Hassabis moves up to chair DeepMind, and Alphabet shares fall 4%. Anthropic starts designing its own chips, Washington drafts restrictions on Chinese optical components, and a DeepMind researcher points out that today's models still cannot invent.
